title: StochasticWeakMinty.lean

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained operator zero-finding on a second-countable real Hilbert space E. The hidden instance is a globally L-Lipschitz map F from E to E with a weak Minty zero.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Each query x returns one stochastic operator value g(x,ξ) using a fresh i.i.d. seed, with mean F(x). The reply contains only the vector. The space data, x₀, L, ρ, σ, R and ε are public. The operator, solution witness, sampling law and oracle map are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticWeakMinty.lean, spec.publicInput, spec.Query, spec.Reply and spec.admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean, IID

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: The jointly measurable oracle map satisfies E‖g(x,ξ)−F(x)‖²≤σ² uniformly over x, with σ≥0. The Lipschitz bound is imposed on the mean operator F.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: There exists x⋆ with F(x⋆)=0 and ‖x⋆−x₀‖≤R such that ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ‖F(x)‖² for every x. The parameters satisfy L>0, R≥0 and 0≤ρ≤1/(20L).

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E‖F(X)‖≤ε for public ε>0, with expectation over the algorithm seed and the independent oracle seed sequence.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: Return one point X in E whose operator residual ‖F(X)‖ is integrable. The criterion uses the first power of the Hilbert norm.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The weak Minty inequality permits a negative inner product with the displacement from a designated zero, controlled by the squared operator residual. This allows structured nonmonotone operators under stochastic point queries.

descriptionHtml:
Stochastic Weak Minty Root Finding

We seek a zero of a Lipschitz operator F:E→E on a separable real Hilbert space E. A zero within a prescribed distance of the given starting point satisfies the weak Minty condition. At each query x∈E, the oracle uses a fresh independent sample to return an unbiased estimate of F(x) with uniformly bounded variance. For a tolerance ε>0, the goal is an output x¯∈E with integrable residual norm satisfying E∥F(x¯)∥≤ε, where the expectation includes both oracle and algorithm randomness.

The root-finding problem is find x∈E such that F(x)=0. The algorithm receives E with its Borel σ-algebra, the measurable sample space Ω, the starting point x0∈E, and the parameters L,ρ,σ,R,ε, whose ranges are L>0,0≤ρ≤120L,σ≥0,R≥0,ε>0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Lipschitz continuity). For every x,y∈E, ∥F(x)−F(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Weak Minty condition). There exists x⋆∈E with F(x⋆)=0 and ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R such that ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ∥F(x)∥2for every x∈E.

Assumption 3 (Stochastic operator oracle). On call k, a query at any x∈E returns g(x,ξk), where g:E×Ω→E is jointly measurable. The samples (ξk)k≥0 are independent random variables with common law μ on Ω, and the sequence is independent of the algorithm’s randomness. For each x∈E and ξ∼μ, the vector g(x,ξ) is Bochner integrable, the squared error ∥g(x,ξ)−F(x)∥2 is integrable, and Eξ∼μ[g(x,ξ)]=F(x),Eξ∼μ[∥g(x,ξ)−F(x)∥2]≤σ2.

After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must satisfy ∥F(x¯)∥∈L1(P),EP[∥F(x¯)∥]≤ε, where P is the joint law of the algorithm’s randomness and the oracle samples.

theorems.referencesHtml:
• Jelena Diakonikolas, Constantinos Daskalakis, Michael I. Jordan. Efficient Methods for Structured Nonconvex-Nonconcave Min-Max Optimization. 2021. Complexity: O((1+LR2/(hε2))(1+σ2/(Lhε2))) stochastic operator calls for mini-batched Extragradient+ to return a uniformly sampled iterate with E∥F(X)∥≤ε in Rd, where h=1/(42L)−2ρ>0.
  • Sayantan Choudhury, Eduard Gorbunov, Nicolas Loizou. Single-Call Stochastic Extragradient Methods for Structured Non-monotone Variational Inequalities: Improved Analysis under Weaker Conditions. 2023. Complexity: O((1+L2R2/ε2)(1+σ2/ε2)) sampled operator calls for mini-batched stochastic past extragradient to achieve mink<KE∥F(x^k)∥2≤ε2 in Rd under uniform variance σ2 and ρL≤1/20.
theorems.formulaHtml: ⌈219⋅(1+L2⋅R2ε2)⋅(1+σ2ε2)⌉+

comparisonHtml:
On a separable real Hilbert space, F is L-Lipschitz (L>0) and has a zero x⋆ with ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. For every x, ⟨F(x),x−x⋆⟩≥−ρ∥F(x)∥2, where 0≤ρ≤1/(20L). The jointly measurable oracle uses IID samples ξ, with Eξg(x,ξ)=F(x) and Eξ∥g(x,ξ)−F(x)∥2≤σ2. The target is E∥F(x^)∥≤ε, for ε>0.

Sufficient oracle budgets for stochastic weak Minty root finding
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) StochasticWeakMintyExtragradient (Ours) (review) O((1+L2R2ε2)(1+σ2ε2)) calls
(2) EG+ (Diakonikolas et al. 2021, Thm. 4.5(i)) O((1+L2R2sε2)(1+σ2sε2)) calls in Rd (1) formalizes the known rate for ordinary extragradient on separable Hilbert spaces. On the shared ρ range, s is bounded below by a universal constant. (1) requires ρL≤1/20. (2) allows ρL<1/(82) and certifies a mean-square residual bound for the random output.
(3) Past extragradient (Choudhury et al. 2023, Thm. 4.5) O(ε−4) component calls for mink<KE∥F(x^k)∥2≤ε2, with other parameters fixed. (1) returns a random iterate. (3) bounds the best index without identifying it and assumes finite-sum sampling with the expected residual condition. Rates across these noise models are incomparable. (1) needs uniform variance control and two fresh batches per full step. (3) uses one batch per step, measures noise at x⋆, and allows ρL<1/2.
(4) Minibatching (Alacaoglu and Kim 2026, Thm. 2.1) O~(ε−4) calls with increasing batches (1) matches the polynomial accuracy dependence without logarithms, using a constant batch size on the unconstrained, bounded-variance overlap in Rd. (1) requires uniform variance and an unconstrained domain. (4) allows constraints, variance up to B2∥x−x0∥2+σ2, and ρL<72/(360+2056).
(5) Multilevel Monte Carlo (Alacaoglu and Kim 2026, Thm. 3.1) O~(ε−4) calls in expectation (1) gives a deterministic call budget with the same polynomial accuracy dependence and no logarithms on the unconstrained, bounded-variance overlap in Rd. (1) requires ρL≤1/20 and uniform variance. (5) allows ρL<1, constraints, and variance up to B2∥x−x0∥2+σ2.

Abbr: s=1−82Lρ. K counts iterations. B controls variance growth. O~ suppresses logarithmic factors in 1/ε with other parameters fixed as ε↓0.

import LongTails.Template
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.StochasticWeakMinty

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.completeE Params.measurableE
  Params.borelE Params.countableE Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := p.E → p.E
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.ρ ∧ p.ρ ≤ 1 / (20 * p.L) ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 ≤ p.R ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p F O :=
    ∃ (g : p.E → p.Ω → p.E) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure p.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → p.Ω)),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
        (fun k (ξ : ℕ → p.Ω) => ξ k) (μ : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
      O = { Seed := fun _ => p.Ω
            law := P
            answer := fun _ (_, x) ω => g x ω } ∧
      (∀ x y, ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∃ xstar, F xstar = 0 ∧ ‖xstar - p.x0‖ ≤ p.R ∧
        ∀ x, -p.ρ * ‖F x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪F x, x - xstar⟫) ∧
      Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (g x) (μ : Measure _)) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂(μ : Measure _) = F x) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - F x‖ ^ 2) (μ : Measure _)) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, ‖g x ω - F x‖ ^ 2 ∂(μ : Measure _) ≤ p.σ ^ 2)
  successful p F output P :=
    Integrable (fun ω => ‖F (output ω)‖) (P : Measure _) ∧
      ∫ ω, ‖F (output ω)‖ ∂(P : Measure _) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.StochasticWeakMinty
